These are the lecture notes for the first part of ENGI 1111, Thermodynamics and
Fluid Mechanics I. Each chapter exists in three printed versions plus this web
version, all built from one source file:

| Version | What it is | When to use it |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **Student copy** | the notes with gaps where the derivations and examples go | print it and bring it to the lecture |
| **Completed copy** | the same notes with every gap filled in | after the lecture, to check your own notes |
| **This website** | the completed notes plus the interactive figures | any time — the figures here you can actually play with |

Problems now sit at the end of the chapter they belong to, rather than on a
separate weekly sheet. One of them is worked through together in class; the rest
are for you, and the worked solutions are in the completed copy and on this site.

## Chapters

- [CH2 — First Law of Thermodynamics](ch02-first-law.qmd)

  *Downloads:* [student copy](pdf/ch02-student.pdf) ·
  [completed copy](pdf/ch02-complete.pdf)

Chapters 1 and 3–6 are still in the old format on Ultra while they are being
converted.

## Supplementary books

- *Thermodynamics* by A. M. Steane (available online)
- *Fundamentals of Thermodynamics*, 7th ed., by C. Borgnakke and R. E. Sonntag
- *Moran's Principles of Engineering Thermodynamics*, 9th ed., by M. J. Moran
- *Engineering Thermodynamics: Work & Heat Transfer*, 4th ed., by Rogers & Mayhew
